blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Prepare a release-convergence candidate that restores automatic combat feedback, makes dense native-renderer qualification measurable without changing gameplay, and completes the ordinary five-wave/result/retry surface with authored arena integrity and truthful upgrade-choice presentation.

diagnosis.root_cause: Release convergence is blocked by three distinct surfaces: lantern attack transactions resolve without an auditable Effects-bus onset/impact path, dense profiling has only software/llvmpipe evidence and lacks native qualification, and the complete ordinary route/release behavior still needs candidate readiness for host recapture. The audio issue has repeated treatments, so this plan uses direct scene-instance/binding restoration rather than another transform adjustment.

stop_conditions: Do not replace or surgically alter preserved authored packages, and preserve native_godot_project and host_godot_boot behavior.
Do not claim native performance qualification when only an external software renderer is available; leave that verdict to host recapture and Tester.
Do not assign or disposition the deferred ordinary-wave issue id in this iteration; implement only the required complete-run product gap and provide retest readiness.
Stop after the three bounded candidate families are implementation-ready for same-loop host recapture and Tester review.

strategy.rationale: Partition the required gaps into independent closure-ready families: restore the combat audio ownership/binding boundary, harden low-overhead dense-profile receipts and renderer gating, and repair the authoritative route/world/lifecycle boundary while carrying the mandatory player-facing choice and spatial capabilities.

code: Run candidate-native GDScript parse/static checks on all touched combat, audio, dense-profile, route, spatial, and upgrade UI files.

Verify development-only tester actions are removed or unavailable in release exports, profiling is inert when disabled, and reset paths clear timers, signals, pooled entities, audio voices, HUD state, wave state, and result flags.
Reconfirm the untouched project.godot baseline and native_godot_project/host_godot_boot preservation requirements.
runtime: Host performs fresh Effects capture for one SEMI-equivalent lantern attack, one quick automatic tap, hit/miss, and reset; inspect mixed waveform plus source-event timeline for exactly-once bounded cues.

Host runs tester_dense_prepare, tester_dense_advance, and tester_dense_reset for three complete cycles at 1920x1080 on the native renderer, retaining software sessions only as rejected evidence and checking runtime logs.

Tester replays ordinary movement from spawn through waves 1-5, Bellkeeper phases, victory/failure Result, Retry, and upgrade draft focus across keyboard, mouse, and gamepad; verify route, collision, visibility, perimeter, and lifecycle predicates.
visual: Recapture shipped gameplay at spawn, critical route, central building/landmark, perimeter, dense combat, upgrade draft, Result, and Retry using sparse state/viewpoint sampling.

Confirm authored cemetery materials, external depth, stable landmark visibility, no proxy-floor/void exposure, no disappearance or occlusion drift, readable HUD hierarchy, truthful upgrade deltas, and distinct focus states.
Pair combat action frames with the audio event timeline so lantern report/impact cues are judged separately from enemy, pickup, ambience, and other Effects voices.

done_when: Each ordinary Warden Lantern authorization produces exactly one bounded, recognizable onset/report on Effects, and each hit or miss produces one distinct bounded impact/recovery cue tied to the same attack id.

Fresh SEMI-equivalent and quick automatic attack windows show non-silent Effects output plus source-event timing aligned with authoritative attack receipts; no generic shot VFX replays the player report.
The retained lantern weapon/audio sources and authored viewmodel hierarchy remain unchanged, and reset, pause, death, victory, and retry retire voices without duplicate or stale events.
Tester has direct black-box audio capture and white-box event receipts for onset, impact, miss, and lifecycle reset, with no new runtime audio errors.
tasks.instructions: Repair the product-owned automatic lantern audio at its instance/binding and routing boundary. Inspect scripts/audio/mournlight_audio_director.gd, scripts/combat/attack_runtime.gd, and the authored audio resource/scene bindings; verify that the actual scene-bound Effects voices have loadable streams, are connected before attack events, and are not overwritten by the generic semantic pool. Use a materially different direct binding/instance restoration strategy from prior transform tuning. Keep onset, impact, and miss ownership keyed to one authoritative attack transaction, preserve distinct enemy cues, and keep all retained weapon/viewmodel assets and source recordings intact.
tasks.title: Restore automatic lantern Effects audio causality

done_when: The candidate exposes bounded baseline, active-swarm, and peak-density samples with frame, physics, render, FPS, entity, effect/light/voice, lifecycle, and runtime-error metrics.

Dense profiling records requested, resolved, reset-isolation, prepare, advance, and reset receipts with stable cycle identity and does not alter spawn budgets, wave pacing, authoritative damage, or ordinary balance.
Profile instrumentation is development/qualification guarded, low overhead when disabled, and release presentation remains unaffected.

Host can run three complete 1920x1080 native-renderer cycles and distinguish native qualification from software/llvmpipe rejection; Tester receives sufficient evidence to close or carry the performance issue.
tasks.instructions: Harden the candidate-side dense profile contract in scripts/gameplay/dense_profile.gd and scripts/gameplay/run_controller.gd. Ensure renderer classification and hardware-eligibility are recorded before sampling but the qualification gate is evaluated only after nonzero frame/physics samples, with deterministic density setup, cycle aggregation, lifecycle reset isolation, and bounded metric history. Keep tester_dense_prepare/advance/reset unbound from release exports and avoid scene-tree scans or per-frame work when profiling is disabled. This task prepares native recapture; it must not manufacture a native verdict from software evidence.
tasks.title: Harden dense native-renderer qualification readiness

done_when: The ordinary run uses all five authored wave ids in order, reaches the Bellkeeper transition and terminal Result exactly once, and Retry starts a clean authoritative run with no stale wave, XP, audio, HUD, or result flags.

The authored arena has expand/larger traversable scale and a coherent external world/external depth; every central building/landmark remains visible and aligned during ordinary movement/movement replay.

Native map streets/terrain, spawn/objective/navigation anchors, collision, boundary/perimeter containment, and camera framing prevent pass-through, void exposure, disappearance, or occlusion drift during route traversal.

Upgrade choices retain a clear visual hierarchy: each card leads with an authored silhouette/icon, shows truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, never uses NEW or LOCKED as a placeholder current value, and supports distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/selected states without changing card dimensions.
Tester can independently prepare and advance route, boss, Result, Retry, and upgrade-choice states and verify ordinary progression rather than a diagnostic jump.
tasks.instructions: Complete the ordinary route and release lifecycle on the existing authored environment, using authoritative wave/run state rather than diagnostic jumps. Ensure expand/larger traversable scale, external world/external depth, central building/landmark visibility, collision, disappearance/occlusion checks, boundary/perimeter containment, and ordinary movement/movement replay all hold from spawn through five waves, Bellkeeper, Result, and Retry. Rebase spawn, objective, and navigation to native authored streets; remove proxy-floor dependence without destructive map surgery. In the same release-shell pass, preserve the HUD upgrade-choice contract with authored visual hierarchy, compact truthful before-to-after deltas, no placeholder CURRENT values, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states.
tasks.title: Complete ordinary route, authored arena, and release lifecycle
